en: Black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing a busy harbor with several steamships and small boats. In the foreground is a quay with pedestrians, early automobiles, bicycles, and kiosks. A moored passenger boat with the name "PRINS …" is visible at left, and various signs and small pavilions line the promenade. Across the water a hilly shoreline is built up with houses, and a tall tower or spire rises in the background. The overall style and vehicles suggest an early‑20th‑century European port city.
